units.source_text: 且说常陆守到三条那屋子里来找他的夫人了。

en.t: Now the Governor of Hitachi came to the house at Sanjo to look for his wife.

units.source_text: 他怒气冲冲地站着叫道：“家中女儿分娩之时，你却独自躲在这里！”

en.t: Standing there in a fury, he cried, "At a time when our daughter at home is giving birth, you are hiding here all by yourself!"

units.source_text: 原来夫人并未把浮舟年来下落和情况如实告诉他。

en.t: It turned out that his wife had not told him the truth about Ukifune's whereabouts and circumstances over the years.

units.source_text: 他以为浮舟已经沦入困境。

en.t: He believed that Ukifune had already fallen into wretched circumstances.

units.source_text: 夫人想等薰大将迎接浮舟入京之后，才把这光彩之事告诉丈夫。

en.t: His wife had meant to wait until General Kaoru brought Ukifune to the capital before telling her husband of this splendid affair.

units.source_text: 但现在弄得这般模样，隐瞒也是徒然，便啼啼哭哭地把情况从头至尾告诉了他，并且拿出薰大将的信来给他看。

en.t: But now that things had come to this, concealment was useless, so she wept as she told him the whole story from beginning to end, and took out General Kaoru's letter for him to see.

units.source_text: 常陆守是个卑鄙之人，崇拜高官贵族，看了这信大吃一惊，反复观玩，说道：“这孩子抛弃了偌大的幸福而死去，真可惜啊！

en.t: The Governor of Hitachi was a vulgar man who worshiped high officials and nobles; when he saw the letter he was astonished, turned it over and admired it again and again, and said, "What a pity that the girl died after throwing away such great good fortune!

units.source_text: 我也是大将的家臣，常常出入邸内，然而从未蒙大将召近身边。

en.t: I too am one of the general's retainers and often go in and out of his residence, yet I have never once been summoned near him.

units.source_text: 他是一位非常尊严的贵人啊！

en.t: He is a nobleman of extraordinary dignity!

units.source_text: 现在蒙他关怀我的儿子，我们真要交运了！”

en.t: Now that he has kindly taken notice of my son, our fortunes are truly about to change!"
His face was full of delight.

units.source_text: 夫人则痛惜浮舟已不在世，只管俯伏哭泣。

en.t: His wife, grieving that Ukifune was no longer in this world, only bent low and wept.

units.source_text: 常陆守此时也流下泪来。

en.t: At this point the Governor of Hitachi also shed tears.

units.source_text: 其实，如果浮舟在世，恐怕薰大将反而不会关怀到常陆守的儿子。

en.t: In truth, if Ukifune had still been alive, General Kaoru probably would not have paid any attention to the Governor of Hitachi's son at all.

units.source_text: 只因他自己做错了事，致使浮舟丧命，心甚抱歉，至少要安慰她母亲，所以顾不得世人讥评了。

en.t: It was only because his own wrongdoing had led to Ukifune's death, leaving him deeply remorseful, that he wanted at least to comfort her mother and no longer cared about the world's criticism.
